questions.question: Which of the following is a popular sport?
'The Olympic Games are held every four years' is a true statement.
Who is known as the 'King of Soccer'?
'The FIFA World Cup is the most prestigious international soccer tournament' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a famous sporting event?
'Serena Williams is a famous tennis player' is a true statement.
Which of the following is a popular winter sport?
'Michael Jordan is considered one of the greatest basketball players of all time' is a true statement.
